scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Cahn–Hilliard: chemical potential as local double-well derivative minus gradient penalty, concentration advanced by periodic Laplacian(mu)
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Centered periodic seven-point Laplacian, explicit Euler; local free-energy diagnostic uses centered gradients
scientific_intent.community_use: A small conserved-phase operator for comparing stencil translation, periodic boundaries and discrete mass conservation; not a validated material coarsening simulation
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All current/previous concentration, chemical potential and local-energy fields against an independent reduced-potential oracle; analytic constant state and discrete mass invariant
limitations: No continuous PDE convergence, coarsening kinetics, or energy-decay theorem established
